title: Amarktai Public Web + Browser Actor
description: Bounded extraction and authorized Chromium rendering of one public HTTPS page. Private/local destinations and robots-disallowed targets are rejected. Form preview never submits.

public_url.title: Public HTTPS URL
public_url.description: A public HTTPS page that the Actor is permitted to fetch or render.

extraction_scope.title: Extraction scope
extraction_scope.description: HTTP modes are lightweight; browser modes render JavaScript and may create a screenshot.

authorization_confirmed.title: Browser authorization confirmed
authorization_confirmed.description: Required for browser modes. Confirms the requested public-page interaction is authorized.

form_values.title: Form fill preview values
form_values.description: Optional public form field-name/value map used only by form_fill_preview. Password, file, hidden and submit controls are never filled and the form is never submitted.
